title: yodel check --json
description: Version 1. Another tool's migrations, replayed and linted (#1): each finding on the migration file that made the change. Within a version, fields are only added; a reader ignores fields it does not know.

status.description: failed when a finding at level error is not silenced: the command exits 3.

migrations.description: The files linted: the ones new since the base that change the schema.

silences.description: Empty: a file's yodel:allow lines show on the findings they silence.

checked.description: The files new since the base, in the tool's order.
